notes.title: Ambush Gamemode Update!
notes.notes:
The new Ambush update is out! Head over to our steam page and/or discord for a full list of what this update entails.

+ Added Ambush Gamemode: This gamemode, as it currently stands, lets you fight against 5 waves of enemies. You can switch between any element at the start of the game, but you have to keep it for the rest of the time.
+ Added Stickler: This grasshopper-like insect bounces around the map. If it sees an enemy nearby, it will hide away in its spikey shell.
+ Added Spiny Stickler: This variant of the stickler will shoot out its spikes when an enemy is nearby. It's sprite-work is currently not in. Watch for a patch soon to update that.
+ Added Flitcut Drone: This small flying insect flutters about the map. If it spots an enemy, it will hunt it down for an attack! Watch out for swarms of them!
* Updated most of the player moves. They are still being worked on, but look a lot nicer now.
+ Added a shader system. Currently, the only shader being used at the moment is a screen shake when the player does certain attacks.

notes.title: Stable Release
notes.notes:
[b]Hello, community![/b] The [b]Project Amaranth[/b] development team has been considering ways to bring content to you faster. What we have come up with is a [b]“Stable Release.”[/b] Those of you with the demo will be able to access early content ahead of our bigger releases. This will include new map editor features, possibly new gamemodes, and more! The [b]Stable Release[/b] is available now.

To access: You must have the demo downloaded. Right click 'Project Amaranth' and click properties. Go to the betas tab and in the drop down menu select 'stable.' The game will update automatically.

As always development will continue on our bigger release of the [b]Nature Region[/b]. We hope you continue to be patient with us as we make further progress.

[b]Enjoy!
[/b]
